jobs.title: Security Operations & GPS Monitoring Specialist
jobs.description:
Security Operations & GPS Monitoring Specialist

Guard 1 Security

Guard 1 Security is seeking a dependable, detail-oriented Security Operations & GPS Monitoring Specialist to join our team. This position plays an important role in supporting daily security operations through GPS monitoring, alarm response, customer communication, reporting, and coordination with field personnel and management.

The ideal candidate is organized, comfortable working with technology, able to multitask, and capable of making sound decisions in a fast-paced environment. Strong communication skills and attention to detail are essential.

Position ResponsibilitiesGPS Monitoring & Daily Operations

  • Plan and monitor the day-to-day operations of GPS tracking systems.
  • Review incoming GPS tracking requests and prioritize job responsibilities for the day.
  • Monitor GPS tracking activity to ensure accurate and up-to-date information.
  • Process GPS tracking requests that require situational review.
  • Respond to system and device alarms and manage incidents according to established procedures.
  • Monitor real-time security activity and identify potential issues requiring attention.
  • Analyze real-time security and supply chain information to assist with operational decision-making.
  • Follow company procedures while efficiently utilizing available resources.
  • Coordinate responsibilities and break times with co-workers and applicable personnel.
  • Communicate special needs or requests for assistance to supervisors and management.

Reporting & Shift Handoffs

  • Prepare daily reports, shift pass-downs, and other operational documentation.
  • Utilize Microsoft Office programs, primarily Excel and Word, to maintain records and prepare reports.
  • Review information from previous shifts to ensure continuity of operations.
  • Ensure outstanding issues and requests are properly communicated to the appropriate personnel.

AI Annotation & Technology

  • Review AI-generated suggestions within company systems.
  • Accept, correct, or modify AI suggestions as needed to improve system accuracy and performance.
  • Maintain familiarity with GPS tracking systems, company portals, and other operational technology.
  • Participate in training related to new systems, procedures, software, and company portal upgrades.

Customer & Internal Communication

  • Monitor company email and text communications and respond or route requests as needed.
  • Review emails and communications from previous shifts to ensure incoming requests have been addressed.
  • Communicate through company email, text messaging, and WhatsApp accounts as required.
  • Make and receive telephone calls as necessary.
  • Communicate professionally with customers, employees, supervisors, vendors, and management.
  • Respond promptly and professionally to questions, concerns, and operational requests.

Knowledge & Professional Development

  • Receive and participate in training related to GPS tracking procedures and company systems.
  • Maintain current knowledge of company procedures, technology, and operational requirements.
  • Participate in refresher training as required.
  • Report knowledge gaps, system issues, or training needs to management.
  • Maintain a willingness to learn new technology, procedures, and operational processes.

Other Duties

  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned by management.

Education & Experience

  • High school diploma or GED required.
  • Some college or military experience preferred, but not required.
  • Minimum of three years of relevant industry experience preferred.
  • Previous experience in security operations, dispatch, GPS monitoring, security management, logistics, transportation, or a related field is preferred.
  • Experience working with GPS tracking or monitoring software is a plus.

Required Licenses & Certifications

  • Valid state-issued driver's license.
  • State of Texas Level III Security Officer License.
  • Additional professional certifications may be required depending on job responsibilities.

Skills & Qualifications

The successful candidate should demonstrate:

  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple responsibilities simultaneously.
  • Ability to remain calm and professional in stressful or time-sensitive situations.
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to identify issues, evaluate information, and determine appropriate courses of action.
  • Strong customer service skills.
  • Ability to work independently while also functioning effectively as part of a team.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Ability to maintain stable performance under pressure or opposition.
  • Professional and collaborative approach when working with employees, customers, vendors, and management.
  • Initiative and willingness to take ownership of assigned responsibilities.

Computer & Technology Skills

  • Computer literate.
  • Intermediate proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Word and Excel.
  • Comfortable using internet-based and web-based software applications.
  • Ability to learn GPS tracking systems, company portals, communication platforms, and other job-specific technology.
  • Ability to work with multiple computer systems and applications simultaneously.

Communication Requirements

The position requires the ability to:

  • Read, write, and communicate effectively in English.
  • Communicate professionally with individuals from diverse backgrounds.
  • Prepare job-related reports and business correspondence.
  • Clearly communicate information to management, employees, customers, and vendors.
  • Respond appropriately and professionally to questions, requests, and operational situations.

Working Conditions

Work is generally performed in an office environment using standard office equipment and computer systems. The working environment is generally favorable, with adequate lighting and temperature.

Work from home may be required during emergency situations.

Physical Requirements

The physical demands described are representative of those required to successfully perform the essential functions of the position. Reasonable accommodations may be made for qualified individuals with disabilities.

While performing the duties of this position, the employee may be required to:

  • Sit for extended periods.
  • Talk and communicate by telephone and other electronic communication systems.
  • Hear and respond to verbal communications and alarms.
  • Use hands and fingers to operate computers, keyboards, telephones, and other equipment.
  • Reach with hands and arms.
  • Maintain close, distance, peripheral, and depth vision necessary to monitor computer screens, GPS systems, and operational information.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who is reliable, organized, technology-minded, and able to think critically under pressure. This position is ideal for someone who enjoys monitoring operations, solving problems, communicating with people, and making sure important details do not get missed.

Full Time, Nights, 6 pm - 6 am

At Houston Methodist, the Security Officer position is responsible for maintaining a safe and secure environment for patients, staff and visitors by patrolling and monitoring hospital premises and personnel. This position provides assistance with personal protection, traffic control and emergency response services. The Security Officer position may employ Houston Methodist-approved defensive tactics to ensure patient, staff and visitor safety.

FLSA STATUS

Non-exempt

QUALIFICATIONS

EDUCATION

High School diploma or equivalent education (examples include: GED, verification of homeschool equivalency, partial or full completion of post-secondary education, etc.)

EXPERIENCE

Criminal justice, security or related experience preferred

LICENSES AND CERTIFICATIONS

Required

Security Officer state license: Security Officer Non-Commissioned, submission of application within 14 days of hire date, and obtained within one year of employment or Security Officer Commissioned Level 3 or Personal Protection Officer Level 4 licensure

DL - Driver License - State Licensure - Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation_PSV Must obtain a Texas DL within 90 days

KNOWLEDGE AND ABILITIES

Demonstrates the skills and competencies necessary to safely perform the assigned job, determined through on-going skills, competency assessments, and performance evaluations

Sufficient proficiency in speaking, reading, and writing the English language necessary to perform the essential functions of this job, especially with regard to activities impacting patient or employee safety or security

Ability to effectively communicate with patients, physicians, family members and co-workers in a manner consistent with a customer service focus and application of positive language principles

Must possess strong customer service skills

Understand HIPAA and Patient confidentiality compliance

Demonstrates emergency preparedness knowledge

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

PEOPLE ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Maintains high customer satisfaction while providing the highest level of safety and security to patients, visitors, staff and assets.

Uses professional telephone etiquette. Communicates effectively with management and coworkers on tasks, processes and procedures.

Actively responds to requests for personal security coverage, assistance with directions, information and guidance.

Promotes a positive work environment and contributes to a dynamic, team focused work unit that actively helps one another to achieve optimal department results. Contributes towards improvement of department scores for employee engagement, i.e. peer-to-peer accountability.

SERVICE ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Secures premises and personnel by patrolling facilities; monitoring surveillance cameras; monitoring access points permitting entry as needed, which may include morgue area.

Responds to all radio dispatches, answers calls and complaints and accurately assesses, responds timely, provides appropriate assistance and makes recommendations as needed for all emergent situations.

QUALITY/SAFETY ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Accurately communicates and/or generates and completes reports by recording occurrences, information, observations, surveillance activities and conducting witness interviews.

Responds immediately to all emergency codes and takes appropriate action.

Maintains a safe environment, following all policies and procedures for safety, hazardous material, emergency preparedness and HIPAA.

FINANCE ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Prevents loss and damage by reporting irregularities, informing violators of policy and procedures.

Utilizes and maintains HM and department equipment according to manufacturer specifications.

Utilizes resources with cost effectiveness and value creation in mind. Self-motivated to independently manage time effectively and prioritize daily tasks, assisting coworkers as needed.

GROWTH/INNOVATION ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Implements actions that promote workplace safety culture and proactively prevents workplace violence.

Supports hospital and department goals and offers innovative solutions through participation in department projects. Assumes responsibility for self-growth and development by participating in in-services programs and continuing education. Ensures own career discussions occur with appropriate management. Completes and updates the My Development Plan on an on-going basis.

jobs.title: Access and Surveillance Engineer
jobs.description:
About the position

Installs, maintains, and repairs physical security and monitoring systems. They are responsible for troubleshooting network-connected cameras, electronic door locks, card readers, and alarm systems to ensure commercial and government facilities remain secure.

Responsibilities

  • Mount hardware (cameras, sensors, panels) and run low-voltage cabling (Cat5e, Cat6, coaxial).
  • Conduct routine inspections, test system hardware, and perform software/firmware updates.
  • Diagnose and resolve connectivity issues between security devices, networks, and monitoring stations.
  • Program access permissions, configure Cloud / Network Video Recorders (NVRs), and map camera views.
  • Instruct facility staff and security personnel on how to use access control software and monitoring interfaces.

Requirements

  • A 2-year technical degree or equivalent experience in IP networking, low-voltage wiring, or electronic security.
  • Understanding of TCP/IP, LAN/WAN, and IP-based camera and cloud systems.
  • Proficiency with industry-standard platforms (e.g., Avigilon, Genetec, Lenel, Axis, Ubiquiti, Verkada).
  • Ability to travel frequently to field locations, including overnight trips
  • Ability to climb ladders
  • Ability to operate aerial lifts
  • Ability to work in tight spaces
  • Ability to lift up to 50 lbs
  • Valid Drivers License
